notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
description:
Deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
Sun-Crowned Hunters and Fiendlash trigger.
Resolve the Sun-Crowned Hunters trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Fiendlash trigger, targeting you, but dealing damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters instead due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.
